The Difference

The Prestige Standard

Same seat. Same angle. Same car. The only thing that changed is the hours in between.

Ground-in dirt on cloth doesn't come out with a wipe-down — it takes extraction, the right chemistry for the material, and the patience to work it in sections.

  • Fabric extracted
  • Seams, stitching, and side bolsters worked by hand
  • Dried properly so nothing comes back damp

Questions

Frequently Asked

Do I need to provide water or power?

Access to an outdoor water is ideal. If that's not available at your location, let us know when booking and we'll work out an alternative.

How long does a detail take?

Most exterior services take 45–55 minutes. Interiors and the Full Packages typically run 1–4 hours depending on vehicle size and condition.

Do you travel outside of Kent?

Yes, we regularly serve the surrounding area. Enter your address at booking and we'll confirm availability and any travel fee.

What if my car needs more than a standard clean?

Heavier soiling, pet hair, or biohazard situations are priced separately and confirmed on-site before we start.

How do I pay?

Payment is collected on completion. We'll confirm accepted methods when we get in touch to schedule your appointment.
